material.body: Neither box select nor click select has double-click select-all-units-of-this-type-on-screen, which WC3 and Dota both have. Source: hy3d human-interaction review.
material.subject: No double-click select-all-of-type on screen
material.witness: scenarios/moba/controls.lua:182-190 (same_kind_on_screen) and :509-511 (double-click branch). Live witness dispatch 1792850561859-3163-b77779a548c4fc52 (run-dbl-final.log): RESULT controls-double-click-select-type=PASS. Double-click on the hero selects [0,138,139], both same-type units inside the viewport; the same-type unit at 140 outside the viewport is excluded; a single click selects [0] only. Premise refuted: double-click select-all-of-type already exists (commit d498df50).
